correctness.rationale: The proof reduces residue support to an integer moment problem with exactly determined mean and variance, proves the sharp minimum and maximum variances on the finite lattice, constructs every intermediate variance by a same-mean convex mixture, and converts the count law into pairwise-independent Bernoulli coordinates through conditional uniform subsets. The q^2-1 threshold and q^2-2 obstruction are proved symbolically. The exact-rational replay confirms all identities over a broad finite range without replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The result identifies an exact structural threshold for a basic nonmonotone statistic under limited independence. Above q^2-1, pairwise independence imposes no restriction whatsoever on the full law of the Hamming weight modulo q; below it, the theorem gives a concrete lattice-moment obstruction. This sharp all-moduli statement is substantially stronger than a single example or finite computation and directly quantifies the expressive power of pairwise independence.
